statement: Nebius lists HGX H100 on-demand at $3.85 per GPU-hour on its public pricing page as of 2026-09-17.
why: A published on-demand rental level for the prior-generation Hopper part anchors where neocloud list pricing sits before any announced change.

impact.mechanism: List rental rates are a display overlay on GPU economics; this page states a level only, with no baseline or change alongside it.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published list page; a posted level, not a transacted or surveyed price.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 7.85 -> 3.85 (tol 1%); sources: Nebius AI Cloud (official pricing page)
